title: Fresh Registration Timestamp
description: A new account should carry the moment it actually joined the fleet, not a null placeholder waiting to be filled in later.
successCondition: POST /api/auth/register a new account and note the current wall-clock time. The response body's user.createdAt is a valid ISO timestamp within a few seconds of that moment. Querying the users table via `npm run db:psql` for that row's created_at confirms it is NOT NULL and matches the same timestamp returned in the API response (to the second).
hints: createdAt on the users table defaults to now() at insert time (see prisma/schema.prisma) — there's no separate code path that sets it later.
Postgres stores the column as created_at (snake_case) even though Prisma/the API expose it as createdAt.
